idea-plugin.name: OI Runner
idea-plugin.description: Runs or debugs the C/C++ file you are looking at, using CLion's own single-file build, then prints wall time, CPU time and peak memory into the Run console when the process exits. The wall time comes from the kernel's own process timestamps, so it stays accurate for programs that redirect stdin/stdout with freopen and finish before the console appears, and debug sessions are timed on the debuggee itself instead of the whole debugger session. Release and debug builds get separate compiler options, editable under Settings | Tools | OI Runner.

action.description: Build the current C/C++ file with the release compiler options, run it, then report wall time, CPU time and peak memory
Build the current C/C++ file with the debug compiler options and run it without the debugger, for a timing comparison
Debug the current C/C++ file with the debug compiler options; when the debuggee exits, wall time, CPU time and peak memory are reported for it
